items.name: Bulldog Holiday Bash 2021
items.information: # Registration is closed and the waitlist is full. **Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.** **All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:** **1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, December 3rd is insufficient for entrance to the competition.** **OR** **2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, December 14th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.** You may submit your documents early by submitting them to this [form](https://forms.gle/pYBXzKcyr2pKmULw5)

Each competitor is allowed at most 1 spectator, whose venue admission fee is 10000 WON (separate from the entrance fee to the garden.) 대회 참가 신청 승인은 자동이 아닌 수동으로 이루어집니다. 참가비 입금 후, 3일이 지나도 참가자 명단에 본인의 이름이 올라오지 않았을 경우 이메일을 보내주세요. Approval of the competitor registrations is done manually, not automatically. If you name does not appear on the list after 3 days of transferring the competition fees, then please send us an email.

items.name: Tartu Open 2021
items.information: Kui olete **vähemalt 12-aastane**, peate esitama ühe järgmisest kahest dokumendist: 1. Covid-19 vastase vaktsineerimise tõendi, kusjuures vaktsineerimiskuur peab olema lõpetatud; 2. Covid-19 läbipõdemise tõendi, kusjuures positiivne testitulemus peab olema saadud viimase kuue kuu jooksul; Võistlejad/külalised, kes on **12-17 aasta vanused**, võivad selle asemel esitada negatiivse PCR testi tulemuse (mitte vanem kui 72 h) või negatiivse antigeeni kiirtesti tulemuse (mitte vanem kui 48 h), kusjuures testi peab olema läbi viinud meditsiinitöötaja - tulemus peab kajastuma Digiloos. Võistluspaigas on maskikandmine **kohustuslik**. --- If you are **at least 12 years old**, after arriving at the venue you must present one of the following: 1. Proof of vaccination against Covid-19. Vaccination has to be completed; 2. Proof that you have recovered from Covid-19. The positive test result must be newer than six months; Alternatively, competitors/guests who are **12 to 17 years old** may present a negative result from either a PCR test (no older than 72h) or an antigen test (no older than 48h) (tests performed by a medical professional). Wearing a mask at the competition venue is **mandatory**. ![Eesti kuubik](https://i.imgur.com/Cr7XSizt.png)
